'''Skeleton ranger''' is a [[monster]] encountered during [[Ancient Awakening]] and in the standard and hard modes of the [[Ungael combat activity]].

During Ancient Awakening their [[life points]] are reduced to 70% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. The player fights them with their expedition party in the tower on [[Ungael]], with one of them appearing in the sixth wave, two in the seventh wave, one in the ninth wave, and one in the tenth wave, along with many other monsters.

In the standard mode of the Ungael combat activity two of them appear in each wave starting from the fifth until eleventh, along with many other monsters.

In the hard mode of the Ungael combat activity their life points are increased to 150% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. Two of them appear in the first wave, three in second, two in third, fourth, and fifth, three in sixth and seventh, and one in the eighth, ninth, eleventh, and twelfth, along with many other monsters.
